passages.context: The complete Latin article and its source notes were inspected for Eucharistic sacrifice in priestly holiness, including « opus nostrae redemptionis continuo exercetur » and source note 105's identification of the Roman Missal prayer over the offerings for the Ninth Sunday after Pentecost.
passages.notes: The article reuses the Secret's clause with continuo inserted; it does not reproduce the liturgical wording verbatim. The note supplies an explicit source-of-source attribution to the Missal. It does not replace direct collation of the liturgical witness or make every consumer of this passage a consumer of the complete Missal.
